rec.name: Global Headline Section (Customizable Heading + Subheading)
rec.status: Built — internal testing/documentation (feedback requested Apr 2025); thin spec

what.text: A reusable, theme-editor-driven headline section that can be placed on any page. It shows a customizable heading with an optional subheading, and the subheading's text alignment can be set. It is a rebuild of the 'Focal' theme headline feature from the elbdev theme (linked Pitch documentation), and it should be installable by non-developers.

why.text: A clear headline with a short supporting subheading breaks long pages into scannable blocks. It states the key message or value proposition at the point where it matters and guides visitors down the page. This is a supporting UX/messaging element, not a direct conversion driver, so the expected lift is small and depends on the copy.

how.text: Build a standalone Shopify section (Liquid + schema) with a heading text setting and an optional subheading. Add a text-alignment select for the subheading (left, center, right). Keep everything editable in the theme editor so non-developers can add it to any template. Mirror the behavior of the elbdev/Focal headline section, and check the linked Pitch documentation for the exact reference behavior. Comments mention a 'Sectionfy' reference for the customizable heading, and a product image was later supplied for documentation.

items: Placement on any page template via the theme editor (installable by non-devs)

dependencies.text: No metafields or apps are mentioned. It assumes a Shopify OS 2.0 theme with sections that can be added in the theme editor. The reference behavior is documented in an external Pitch presentation (elbdev Focal theme), which was not reviewed. The exact styling, heading-size options and any further settings are not specified in the ticket.

items: Click-through rate on the CTAs that follow the headline
Engagement and bounce rate on pages where it is used
Conversion rate of the page template (A/B test vs. without the section)
